blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive image generation has recently emerged as a competitive visual generation paradigm, yet its generation order is often predefined or heuristic, such as next-patch prediction, random-order prediction, or one-step generation for specific scales. We observe that these strategies can cause models to overlook important structural dependencies in images, thereby limiting both structural robustness and reasoning capability. In this work, we propose a context-aware autoregressive generation framework, where the model dynamically determines the next token location based on global context and current local information. Rather than following a fixed or random order, our method allows the generation process to adapt to image structure and semantic dependencies. Extensive experiments show that context-aware generation significantly improves structural robustness across different image AR paradigms, including masked autoregressive and scale-wise autoregressive models. Beyond quantitative improvements, we further observe emerging reasoning properties: the model can better understand complex semantic instructions and generate images that more faithfully follow the given guidance. These findings suggest that generation order is a critical yet underexplored factor in image autoregressive modeling, and that context-aware decoding can unlock stronger reasoning-aware visual generation capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/Hpesojyjx/Saccades-AR.
blocks.zh: 自动回转的图像生成最近作为一个竞争性的视觉生成范式出现,然而其生成顺序常常是预先定义的或有弹性的,如下一幅预测,随机顺序预测,或针对特定尺度的单步生成. 我们认为,这些战略可能导致模型忽略图像中重要的结构依赖性,从而限制结构稳健性和推理能力。 在这项工作中,我们提出一个了解上下文的自动生成框架,其中模型根据全球背景和当前本地信息,动态地确定下一个符号位置. 我们的方法不是遵循固定或随机的顺序,而是允许生成过程适应图像结构和语义依赖性. 广泛的实验表明,对上下文的认识生成大大改进了不同图像AR范式的结构稳健性,包括蒙面自递性和尺度自递性模型. 除了定量改进外,我们进一步观察到新出现的推理属性:模型可以更好地理解复杂的语义指示,生成更忠实地遵循给定指导的图像. 这些研究结果表明,生成顺序是图像自动递归模型中一个关键但探索不足的因素,而上下文感知解码可以解锁更强的推理感知视觉生成能力. 代码见https://github.com/Hpesojyjx/Saccades-AR。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Inspired by the success of next-token prediction in natural language processing, recent years have witnessed a growing interest in autoregressive (AR) image generation. Early efforts directly transferred the language modeling recipe to visual generation by flattening 2D images, pixels, or discrete visual tokens into 1D sequences and modeling them with standard autoregressive Transformers, following a raster or otherwise fixed token order ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Ramesh et al., 2021 ; Esser et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2022 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . While conceptually simple and scalable, this direct transfer is not perfectly aligned with the spatial nature of images. Unlike text, where the generation order often follows a natural linguistic progression, images contain dense 2D structures and long-range spatial dependencies that do not naturally conform to a single left-to-right sequence. As a result, fixed-order AR generation can easily underutilize important structural cues, leading to visible artifacts such as row-wise or column-wise misalignment, distorted object layouts, and weakened global coherence. To alleviate these limitations, subsequent works explored more flexible generation schemes, including masked generative modeling that predicts randomly masked tokens or iteratively refines token sets ( Chang et al., 2022 ; Chang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024c ; Kim et al., 2025b ) , as well as scale-wise autoregressive generation that predicts visual tokens progressively from coarse to fine resolutions ( Tian et al., 2024b ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025b ) , which reduce the rigidity of raster decoding and improve visual fidelity and structural stability.
blocks.zh: 受自然语言处理中下手预测的成功启发,近年来出现了对自动(AR)图像生成的日益浓厚的兴趣. 早期的努力直接将语言建模配方转移到视觉生成,将2D图像,像素,或离散的视觉符号平整成1D序列,并按照光栅或其他固定的符号顺序用标准自旋变形器建模(Chen等人,2020年;Ramesh等人,2021年;Esser等人,2021年;Yu等人,2022年;Sun等人,2024年). 这种直接转移虽然在概念上简单且可扩展,但并不完全符合图像的空间性质。 与文本不同的是,生成顺序往往跟随自然语言进化,图像包含密集的2D结构和长距离的空间依赖性,它们自然不符合单一的左对右序列. 因此,定序AR生成可以很容易地低估重要的结构提示,导致可见的文物如行向或列向错配,扭曲对象布局,削弱全球一致性. 为了减轻这些限制,后来的作品探索了更灵活的生成计划,包括遮盖的基因模型预测随机遮蔽的代号或迭代精炼代号套件(Chan等人,2022年;Chang等人,2023年;Li等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年c;Kim等人,2025年b),以及规模自递性生成,预测视觉代号从粗细到精细分辨率(Tian等人,2024年b; Ma et al., 2024; Han et al., 2025b),它降低了光栅解码的刚性,提高了视觉的忠诚度和结构稳定性.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Generation order shapes reasoning-like behaviors in autoregressive image generation. With random-order decoding (top), intermediate predictions remain scattered and incomplete, weakening feedback for counting (e.g., “four vases") and often causing over-generation. With context-aware location selection (bottom), the same model and seed tend to complete objects more coherently (roughly one-by-one) and stop adding new ones once the count is met.
blocks.zh: 图1:生成顺序塑造了自动递归图像生成中类似推理的行为. 在随机顺序解码(top)下,中间预测仍然零散且不完整,弱化了计数的反馈(如"四个花瓶"),并经常引起过量生成. 在对上下文有认识的位置选择(从下到下)的情况下,同样的模型和种子往往会更连贯地完成对象(大致是逐一完成),一旦达到计数就停止添加新的对象.

blocks.en: Nonetheless, although random-order and scale-wise generation alleviate the structural distortion, the reasoning logic behind patch-level generation remains largely overlooked. For example, when humans draw an image patch by patch, they can usually decide where to draw next based on the existing context. This allows them to build a more coherent spatial organization and progressively reason over the partially completed content. In contrast, masked AR models generate patches in a random order, while scale-wise AR models generate all tokens within a given spatial scale in one step. Both strategies can easily miss an important intermediate reasoning process. We illustrate this issue with an intuitive example in Fig. 1 , where the model is asked to generate four vases . In Case 2, when the model is allowed to determine the next prediction location according to context, an emerging reasoning behavior can be observed. The model generates the vases in an organized manner, roughly one by one, and obtains self-feedback during the generation process. For instance, before step 22, it has already generated three vases. In the following steps, the model appears to recognize that one vase is still missing, and completes the fourth vase by step 25. After the required count is satisfied, the remaining steps are mainly used to fill in the background. In contrast, in Case 1, the random-order AR model selects prediction locations randomly at each step. As a result, most objects remain incomplete during the intermediate generation process, making it difficult for the model to receive reliable feedback about the object count. Consequently, it keeps generating new vase-like regions and fails to align with the required number.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,虽然随机顺序和规模的生成减轻了结构扭曲,但补丁级生成背后的推理逻辑仍然在很大程度上被忽视. 例如,当人类通过补丁绘制一个图像补丁时,他们通常可以根据现有的上下文来决定下一个绘制地点. 这使得它们能够建立一个更加一致的空间组织,并逐步对部分完成的内容提出理由。 相比之下,蒙面的AR模型以随机顺序生成补丁,而比例级的AR模型则在一定空间尺度范围内以一步生成所有符. 这两种战略都很容易错过一个重要的中间推理过程。 我们用图1的直观例子来说明这个问题,请模型产生四个花瓶。 在案例2中,当允许模型根据上下文确定下一个预测位置时,可以观察到一种新出现的推理行为. 该模型有条不紊地生成花瓶,大致逐一生成,并在生成过程中获得自食其力. 例如,在步骤22之前,它已经产生了三个花瓶。 在以下步骤中,模型似乎承认一个花瓶仍然缺失,并在第25步完成第四个花瓶. 在满足要求的计数后,其余步骤主要用于填写背景. 相比之下,在案例1中,随机顺序AR模型在每个步骤随机选择预测位置. 因此,大多数对象在中间生成过程中仍然不完整,使得模型难以收到关于对象计数的可靠反馈. 因此,它不断产生类似花瓶的新区域,无法与所需数目保持一致。

blocks.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose Saccade AR (SAR) 1 1 1 We call our method Saccade AR because it is inspired by saccadic eye movements in the human visual system, which actively choose where to fixate based on context when interpreting a visual scene. , a simple yet surprisingly effective context-aware decoding strategy for AR image generation. In detail, at each decoding step, an AR model typically produces candidate predictions for all editable token positions, after which existing methods commit tokens according to a random, predefined, or scale-wise schedule. Instead, SAR ranks candidate token locations by their semantic relevance to the global context. Specifically, we measure the distance between each candidate token representation and the global conditioning signal, such as the class token in class-conditional generation or text embeddings in text-to-image generation, and prioritize locations from semantically close to semantically distant. In this way, SAR first generates regions that are strongly related to the global intent, and then fills in less critical details. SAR is training-free, lightweight, and broadly applicable. It can be plugged into pretrained AR image models at inference time without changing model parameters, and it introduces almost no additional computation because it only reorders which candidate predictions are committed. Moreover, SAR applies to different AR paradigms, including masked autoregressive models (MAR ( Li et al., 2024c ) ) and scale-wise autoregressive models (VAR ( Tian et al., 2024b ) ). Importantly, SAR does not change the model architecture or supervision; it changes the generation trajectory. Our central thesis is that this trajectory matters : when the model generates in a context-aware order, it can better exploit intermediate visual feedback and exhibit stronger structural robustness and reasoning-related instruction following.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们提出 Saccade AR(SAR) 11, 我们称我们的方法 Saccade AR, 因为它灵感来自人类视觉系统中的圣眼运动, 人类视觉系统在解释视觉场景时, 积极选择基于上下文的固定位置。 具体地说,在每一个解码步骤上,一个AR模型一般会为所有可编辑的符号位置产生候选预测,之后现有方法会按照随机的,预设的,或按比例的进度表来传递符号. 相反,搜索和救援系统将候选地点按其与全球背景的语义相关性排列。 具体地说,我们测量每个候选代号代表与全球条件信号之间的距离,例如类条件生成中的类代号或文本嵌入到文本到图像生成中,并优先排列从精密接近精密距离的位置. 这样,合成孔径雷达首先产生与全球意图密切相关的区域,然后填充不太关键的详情。 搜索和救援是无训练的,轻量级的,而且广泛适用。 它可以在推论时间插入预先训练的AR图像模型而无需改变模型参数,它引入了几乎没有额外的计算,因为它只重排了候选人所承诺的预测. 此外,搜索和救援适用于不同的AR范式,包括蒙面自旋模型(MAR(Li等人,2024c))和规模自旋模型(VAR(Tian等人,2024b)。 重要的是,搜索和救援不会改变模型结构或监督;它会改变生成轨迹。 我们的中心理论是,这个轨迹很重要:当模型在有上下文意识的顺序下产生时,它可以更好地利用中间视觉反馈,并表现出更强的结构稳健性和与推理相关的指示。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments validate this hypothesis. On text-to-image benchmarks such as GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) and DPG-Bench ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , SAR consistently improves pretrained AR generators including MaskGen ( Kim et al., 2025b ) and Infinity ( Han et al., 2025b ) , with especially clear gains on reasoning-related dimensions such as counting, relative positioning, and compositional instruction following. To further evaluate reasoning ability, we construct a long-prompt text-to-image benchmark involving complex combinations of object counts, spatial relations, and fine-grained attribute assignments. On this benchmark, SAR brings even larger improvements, supporting our claim that generation order is a critical factor behind the reasoning limitations of existing AR image models.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验验证了这个假设. 在GenEval(Ghosh等人,2023年)和DPG-Bench(Hu等人,2024年)等文字到图像基准方面,搜索和救援系统不断改进经过预先培训的AR发电机,包括MaskGen(Kim等人,2025年b)和Infinity(Han等人,2025年b),在计算、相对定位和组成指导等推理相关方面特别明显。 为了进一步评价推理能力,我们构建了一个长时速的文本到图像基准,涉及物体计数、空间关系和精细属性分配等复杂的组合。 在这个基准上,搜索和救援带来更大的改进,支持我们的主张,即生成顺序是现有AR图像模型推理限制的一个关键因素。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Touvron et al., 2023a ; Touvron et al., 2023b ; Gemini Team, Google, 2023 ; OpenAI, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) have made autoregressive (AR) models central to modern generative modeling, due to their flexibility and wide use in predicting each next token from prior tokens. First developed for text, AR models are now also widely used for visual generation ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Esser et al., 2021 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024b ) , where each image is treated as a sequence of discrete tokens. The same idea has further led to unified vision–language models that handle both multimodal understanding and generation, such as Emu3 ( Emu3 Team, BAAI, 2024 ) , LaVIT ( Jin et al., 2023 ) ,and VILA-U ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . In these models, one shared AR backbone reads and writes mixed text and image tokens.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的近期进步(Brown等人,2020年;Touvron等人,2023a;Touvron等人,2023b;双子团队,Google,2023年;OpenAI,2024年;杨等人,2024年)使得自递性模型(AR)成为现代基因模型的核心,因为其灵活性和广泛用于从先前的符号中预测每个下个符号. AR模型最初是为文字开发的,现在也广泛用于视觉生成(Chen等人,2020年;Esser等人,2021年;Sun等人,2024年;Tian等人,2024年a;Li等人,2024年b),其中将每个图像作为离散符号的序列处理. 同样的想法进一步导致统一视觉-语言模式,既处理多式联运的理解,又处理生成,如Emu3(Emu3 Team, BAAI, 2024),LaVIT(Jin等人, 2023),和VILA-U(Wu等人, 2024). 在这些模型中,一个共享的AR骨干读写混合文本和图像符号.

blocks.en: Early research on AR visual modeling adopts language model architectures to generate images pixel by pixel ( Chen et al., 2020 ) . With the help of image tokenizers ( Van Den Oord et al., 2017 ; Esser et al., 2021 ) , later AR models produce images as discrete token sequences in a next-token manner, where each image is flattened into a 1D sequence and predicted by a decoder-only transformer, similar to language modeling. This pipeline has been scaled up to large-scale text-conditioned generation, such as DALL-E ( Ramesh et al., 2021 ) , CogView ( Ding et al., 2021 ; Ding et al., 2022 ) , Make-A-Scene ( Gafni et al., 2022 ) , Parti ( Yu et al., 2022 ) , LlamaGen ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , and Lumina-mGPT ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , with parallel extensions to text-to-video models such as VideoPoet ( Kondratyuk et al., 2023 ) . However, these methods produce image tokens in raster-scan order, which does not fully use the 2D structure of natural images, leading to structural artifacts and weakened coherence under complex semantic instructions.
blocks.zh: 早期关于AR视觉建模的研究采用语言模型架构,通过像素生成图像像素(Chen等人,2020年). 借助于图像标识器( Van Den) Oord et al., 2017 ; Esser et al., 2021 ),后来的AR模型以邻接方式生成作为离散符号序列的图像,其中每个图像被平整成1D序列,并由一个解码器唯一的变压器预测,类似于语言模型. 这条输油管被扩大为大规模的文本条件生成,如DALL-E(Ramesh等人,2021年),CogView(Ding等人,2021年;Ding等人,2022年),Make-A-Scene(Gafni等人,2022年),Parti(Yu等人,2022年),LlamaGen(Sun等人,2024年),Lumina-mGPT(Liu等人,2024年),以及VideoPoet(Kondratyuk等人,2023年)等文本到video模型的平行扩展. 然而,这些方法以光栅扫描顺序产生图像符号,不完全使用自然图像的2D结构,导致结构文物,并在复杂的语义指令下削弱一致性.

blocks.en:
Beyond raster-scan generation, recent works explore two
complementary directions. Mask-based methods predict multiple tokens per step in a non-fixed order:
MaskGIT ( Chang et al., 2022 ) predicts groups of tokens jointly at each step, cutting the inference cost;
Muse ( Chang et al., 2023 ) extends this idea to text-to-image generation; MAGE ( Li et al., 2023 ) unifies representation learning and synthesis under the same masked-token objective. MAR ( Li et al., 2024b ) brings masked prediction to continuous-valued tokens via a small diffusion head, replacing the discrete codebook, and MaskGen ( Kim et al., 2025a ) compresses images into compact 1D tokens for masked text-to-image generation. Scale-wise methods replace the spatial axis with a coarse-to-fine scale axis: VAR ( Tian et al., 2024a ) sums predictions across scales so the inference step count equals the
number of scales, with follow-ups in STAR ( Ma et al., 2024 ) and Infinity ( Han et al., 2025a ) . While both directions alleviate the rigidity of raster-scan, the resulting order is still either fixed a priori (a predetermined scale schedule, as in VAR) or determined stochastically (random or confidence-based unmasking, as in MaskGIT and MAR)—no existing method dynamically chooses the next step based on the semantic context already produced. This motivates our context-aware generation order, in which the model itself decides where to attend and generate next, analogous to the saccadic behaviour of the human visual system.
blocks.zh:
在光栅扫描的一代之外, 最近的作品探索两个
辅助方向。 基于面具的方法在非固定顺序中预测每个步骤的多个符号:
MaskGIT(Chang等人,2022年)在每个步骤上共同预测各种符号,削减推论成本;
Muse(Chang等人,2023年)将这一想法延伸至文本到图像生成;MAGE(Li等人,2023年)在同一蒙面托肯目标下统一表达学习和合成. MAR(Li et al.,2024b)通过一个小的传播头带给连续值符号的蒙面预测,取代了离散的密码本,MaskGen(Kim et al.,2025a)将图像压缩成紧凑的1D符号,用于蒙面文字到图像生成. 尺度法用粗对细尺度轴取代空间轴:VAR(Tian等人,2024年a)总和跨尺度的预测,因此推断步骤数等于
天平数量,在STAR(Ma等人,2024年)和Infinity(Han等人,2025年a)中进行后续. 虽然两个方向都缓解了光栅扫描的僵硬性,但由此产生的顺序仍然是先定的(如VAR中预设的尺度表)或定型(如MaskGIT和MAR中随机或基于信心的不假冒)——没有现有的方法能动态地根据已经产生的语义背景选择下一步。 这激发了我们的环境意识生成秩序,在这种秩序中,模型本身决定了在哪里参加和产生下一个,类似于人类视觉系统的神圣行为.

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Comparison to one-step and random-order generation paradigms. Our SAR model decides the generation order based on each token’s latent distance to a global token. This is only a minimal change for image AR models, but we find it crucial for the AR model’s reasoning behavior.
blocks.zh: 图2:与单步和随机顺序生成范式的比较. 我们的搜索和救援模式根据每个信物与全球信物的潜在距离来决定生成顺序。 但我们认为这对AR模型的推理行为至关重要。

blocks.en: 3.1 Image Autoregressive Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 图像自动递减模型

blocks.en: Modern image autoregressive models can be grouped into two families that differ in the unit of generation. Patch-wise models tokenize the image into a flat sequence of spatial (or 1D-compressed) latent tokens and predict them one or a few at a time. Scale-wise models predict the image at progressively finer resolutions, generating a coarse-to-fine pyramid of tokens. We describe the patch-wise scale-wise formulations below, and then explain how SAR adapt with them.
blocks.zh: 现代图像自动递归模型可以组合成两个不同生成单位的家族. 补丁模型将图像符号化为空间(或1D压缩)潜伏符号的平序,并一次预测一个或几个. 缩放模型以渐微的分辨率来预测图像,生成粗细的金字塔形的符号. 我们描述下面的补丁缩放,然后解释合成孔径雷达如何适应它们。

blocks.en: We adopt the masked-autoregressive (MAR) formulation ( Li et al., 2024b ) , encoding an image x x into N N continuous latent tokens z = { z i } i = 1 N z=\{z_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} and factorizing the conditional distribution over a generation order π \pi : p θ ( z ∣ c ) = ∏ t = 1 T p θ ( z S t | z S < t , c ) , p_{\theta}(z\mid c)\;=\;\prod_{t=1}^{T}p_{\theta}\!\left(z_{S_{t}}\,\middle|\,z_{S_{<t}},\,c\right), (1) Here c c is a conditioning signal, and { S t } t = 1 T \{S_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} partitions token indices according to π \pi . blocks.en: For MAR, position selection is performed after token-wise diffusion denoising, rather than directly on the deterministic masked-prediction features. At each step, the model first predicts candidates for unresolved positions from the current visible context, and then samples denoised candidate tokens before SAR selects which positions to commit. Diffusion sampling introduces seed-dependent variation, so the first selected position need not be fixed for a given class condition. After each commitment, the updated partial image conditions the next round of candidate generation and ranking.

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate SAR across both patch-wise and scale-wise AR. Sec. 4.1 qualitatively visualizes the intermediate decoded image at every AR step under random vs. SAR; Sec. 4.2 reports our main text-to-image results on MaskGen and Infinity, covering GenEval, DPG-Bench, MJHQ-30K FID, and a complex long-prompt reasoning benchmark we construct (Sec. 4.2.1 ); Sec. 4.3 presents ablations on alternative orders and on the VAR retraining. We also provide class-conditional ImageNet results on MAR and VAR in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4.1 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 定性分析

blocks.en: Before the quantitative results we build intuition for how SAR helps by visualizing the intermediate decoded image at every AR step under random vs. SAR, with the checkpoint and prompt held fixed. We use one representative model per AR family: Infinity-8B (scale-wise) and MaskGen-XL (patch-wise). Implementation details are provided in Sec. 4.2 . The two realize SAR’s improvement through different reasoning behaviors that converge on the same effect.
blocks.zh: 在定量结果之前,我们对搜索和救援如何通过在随机对搜索和救援的每个AR步骤下可视化中间解码图像来帮助建立直觉,并固定检查点和即时控制。 每个AR家族使用一个代表性模型:无限-8B(尺度)和MaskGen-XL(patch-wise). 执行情况详见第4.2节。 两人通过不同的推理行为,

blocks.en: On Infinity-8B (Fig. 3 ), SAR commits to the prompt-correct global outline (count, object identity, and overall geometry) within the first few last-scale steps, and uses subsequent steps only to fill in textures. Random ordering scatters partial textures before any outline is established and often fails to recover those structural decisions by the final step.
blocks.zh: 在Infinity-8B(图3)上,SAR承诺在前几个最后尺度步骤内迅速校正全局轮廓(计数,对象身份,和总体几何),并使用后续步骤只填充纹理. 随机订购会在任何提纲确定之前散开部分纹理,往往无法通过最后步骤收回这些结构决定。

blocks.en: On MaskGen-XL (Fig. 4 ), SAR instead commits one full object at a time, moving on only once the previous object is complete; counting, spatial relations, and compositional hierarchy all fall out of this sequential commitment. Random ordering grows all parts concurrently and resolves identity and layout only in the last few steps.
blocks.zh: 在MaskGen-XL(图4)上,合成孔径雷达一次承诺一个完整的对象,仅在前一个对象完成后才能继续运行;计数、空间关系和构成等级都不属于这一顺序承诺。 随机命令会同时生长所有部分,只在最后几个步骤中解决身份和布局.

blocks.en: The two families realize SAR through complementary mechanisms ( outline-to-detail vs. object-by-object ), but in both cases SAR’s prompt-grounded ordering turns AR decoding into a sequence of legible, prompt-aligned commitments rather than a soup of half-formed concepts. This implicit visual planning emerges for free , and the quantitative results across all 8 8 models in Sec. 4.2 and Appendix B confirm that this behavioral change translates into consistent benchmark gains.
blocks.zh: 这两个家庭通过互补机制(提纲到细节与逐项目标)实现搜索和救援,但在这两种情况下,搜索和救援的即时命令将AR解码转换成可辨认、即时协调的承诺序列,而不是半成型概念的汤。 这种隐含的视觉规划为免费而出现,Sec.4.2和附录B中所有8个模型的量化结果证实,这一行为变化转化为一致的基准收益.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Infinity-8B: outline-to-detail reasoning under SAR. In each strip, the top row is random ordering and the bottom row is SAR; columns are AR steps. Within the first few SAR steps the global outline already encodes the correct count (four candles, six houseplants), the correct object set with no hallucinated extras (fox+rabbit), and the correct global geometry (circular pizza). Subsequent steps fill in textures without changing those structural decisions. Random ordering instead grows partial textures everywhere and frequently fails to recover count, identity, or shape by the final step.

blocks.en: 4.2 Text-to-image generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 文本到图像生成

blocks.en: We evaluate text-to-image SAR on two AR families that span the dominant design choices in the literature: MaskGen ( Kim et al., 2025a ) (patch-wise; MaskGen-L and MaskGen-XL) and Infinity ( Han et al., 2025a ) (scale-wise; Infinity-2B and Infinity-8B). MaskGen takes the SAR anchor to be the singleton { W ​ c pool } \{W\,c_{\mathrm{pool}}\} , with W W the same linear projection MaskGen already uses to inject pooled text conditioning; Infinity takes the SAR anchor to be a = c pool a=c_{\mathrm{pool}} , the attentive-pooled text embedding already consumed by AdaLN. We use T = 32 T{=}32 AR steps for MaskGen and M = 16 M{=}16 equal groups at the last scale for Infinity. All other implementation details follow the original recipes and are listed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们对跨越文献中主导设计选择的两个AR家族进行文字对图像搜索和救援评估:MaskGen(Kim等人,2025年a)(patch-wise;MaskGen-L和MaskGen-XL)和Infinity(Han等人,2025年a)(规模;Infinity-2B和Infinity-8B)。 MaskGen 将 SAR 锚定为 {W c pool }\ W\, c\ mathrm{pool } , W W W 的线性投影 MaskGen 已经用于注入集合文本条件 ; Infinity 将 SAR 锚定为 a = c pool a = c\ mathrm{pool }, AdaLN 已经消耗的专注集合文本嵌入 。 我们使用T=32 T{=}32 AR步为MaskGen,M=16 M{=}16 平等组为无穷级. 所有其他实施细节均沿用原处方,并列于附录A。

blocks.en: We use three complementary benchmarks: GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) for compositional capability, with 4 4 samples per prompt and the prompt-level pass criterion; DPG-Bench ( Hu et al., 2024 ) for fine-grained prompt alignment, scored by the mPLUG-VQA evaluator on a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 image grid; and MJHQ-30K FID ( Li et al., 2024a ) for distribution-level aesthetic quality on a 30K-prompt subset. Following the original Infinity protocol, GenEval is run with prompt rewriting on Infinity; all other settings use raw prompts. All three are averaged over 3 3 seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个补充基准:GenEval(Ghosh等人,2023年)用于组成能力,每秒有4个样本,并采用及时通过标准;DPG-Bench(Hu等人,2024年)用于精细的快速对齐,由mPLUG-VQA评估员在2×2 2 秒的图像网格上打分;MJHQ-30K FID(Li等人,2024a年)用于30K-prompt子集的分布一级美学质量。 遵循原始的"无限协议",GenEval运行时在"无限"上快速重写;所有其他设置都使用原始的提示. 所有三个种子平均超过3个种子.

blocks.en: Tables 2 and 3 show that the inference-only SAR change improves compositional capability at every scale across both paradigms. On GenEval, the Overall pass rate rises consistently, with the largest gains on sub-categories that require global consistency such as Counting , Colors , and Position . On DPG-Bench, the per-category L1 breakdown is mixed but the aggregate Overall score also improves at every scale. On MJHQ-30K FID (Table 4 ), SAR is statistically tied with random at every scale, indicating that the compositional gains do not come at the price of distribution-level aesthetic quality. Together these results demonstrate that a single inference-time intervention generalizes across both patch-wise and scale-wise text-to-image AR. For the scale-wise setting, Appendix C additionally studies SAR-order last-scale retraining of VAR and compares inference orders on the resulting checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 表2和表3显示,仅推论的合成孔径雷达变化提高了两个范式中每个尺度的构成能力。 在GenEval上,总体通过率持续上升,在需要全球一致性的子类别(如计数、颜色和位置)上收益最大。 在DPG-Bench上,每类L1的分数有好有坏,但总体分数在每个尺度上也有改善. 在MJHQ-30K FID(表4)中,SAR在统计上与每个尺度的随机绑定,表明组成收益并不以分布级美学质量为代价. 这些结果共同表明,单一的推论-时间干预可概括地涵盖补丁和规模化的文本对图像AR。 就规模设定而言,附录C还研究了合成孔径雷达的最后规模再培训,并比较了由此产生的检查站的推断命令。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Complex long-prompt benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 复杂的长期即时基准

blocks.en: To complement GenEval and DPG-Bench, we further build a complex long-prompt benchmark to better evaluate reasoning-intensive instruction following. The benchmark contains 2,000 prompts with dense compositional constraints, including object counts, spatial relations, attribute binding, object existence, compositional ordering, and view consistency. A typical prompt is: “A vertical stack of four different items: a wooden donut at the bottom, a metallic sphere in the middle, and a miniature cactus on the very top. This stack is placed inside a hollow red ring. To the front-left of the stack is a spilled glass of milk, and to the back-right is a closed leather book. Cinematic top-down 45-degree angle view.”
blocks.zh: 为了补充GenEval和DPG-Bench,我们进一步建立了一个复杂的长时基准,以便更好地评价随后的推理密集型教学。 该基准包含2,000个具有密集的构成约束的提示,包括对象计数,空间关系,属性约束,对象存在,组成顺序,以及视图一致性. 一个典型的提示是:“四个不同物品的纵向堆叠:底部是木甜甜圈,中间是金属球体,顶部是微型仙人掌。 这个堆放在一个空心的红圈里 堆积的左前方是洒出的牛奶杯,右后方是封闭的皮书. 电影自上而下45度角景. “

blocks.en: For evaluation, we generate images from each prompt using different AR models and decoding orders. We then use Gemini 2.5 Pro ( Gemini Team, Google, 2025 ) as a VLM judge. For each image, we construct 10 question-answer pairs from the prompt, with ground-truth answers directly extracted from the prompt constraints. Gemini is asked to score the match between the generated image and each question on a 1–5 scale. We report the average scores under six reasoning-related categories.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that SAR consistently improves complex instruction following across all three evaluated AR models, raising the average score by roughly + 0.5 +0.5 on each. The largest gains tend to appear on categories that require global consistency (counting, spatial relation, and compositional ordering) where random-order decoding fails to maintain reliable intermediate feedback about how many objects have already been generated or where they should be placed. This supports our hypothesis that generation order is not merely a low-level sampling detail but directly affects whether an AR image model can use partially generated content as feedback and reason over the remaining constraints during generation.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,搜索和救援在所有三种评估的AR模型中不断改进复杂的教学,将平均分数提高大约+0.5+0.5。 最大的收益往往出现在需要全球一致性的类别(计数、空间关系和组成顺序)上,在这些类别中,随机顺序解码无法维持关于已经生成多少物体或应将其放置在何处的可靠的中间反馈。 这支持了我们的假设,即生成顺序不仅仅是一个低层次的采样细节,而是直接影响到AR图像模型是否能够使用部分生成的内容作为反馈和理性来应对生成过程中剩余的制约.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: To check that the gains of SAR are not a trivial side-effect of merely abandoning the random baseline, we compare it against two deterministic alternatives: Sequential , which generates tokens one by one in their natural index order, and Inside-out , which starts from the middle token and expands outward symmetrically. We evaluate them on one representative model from each AR family: MaskGen-XL (patch-wise) and Infinity-8B (scale-wise). Table 5 reports GenEval and DPG-Bench Overall scores under all four orders. SAR consistently outperforms all three alternative orderings on both benchmarks and on both models, indicating that what matters is conditioning the choice of next position on the prompt itself, rather than simply imposing a structural pattern.

blocks.en: MaskGIT ( Chang et al., 2022 ) selects positions using prediction confidence, whereas SAR explicitly ranks candidate representations by their alignment with the conditioning anchor. Both rules can depend on the current context; the distinction is the scoring criterion, not dynamic selection alone. We replace the confidence selector in a pretrained MaskGIT-Base checkpoint with SAR, keeping the checkpoint, 12-step cosine schedule, classifier-free guidance setting, and 50K class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 sample count fixed, without retraining. Table 6 shows lower FID and higher recall under SAR, isolating the benefit of the selection criterion.
blocks.zh: MaskGIT(Chang等人,2022年)使用预测置信度来选择职位,而SAR则通过与调制锚的配合来明确排列候选人代表的排名. 这两种规则都可能取决于当前的上下文;区别是评分标准,而不仅仅是动态选择. 我们用搜索和救援系统取代预先训练过的MaskGIT-Base检查站的置信选择器,保留检查站,12步余弦时间表,无分类指导设置,50K级有条件的ImageNet256×256256\time256样本计数固定,不进行再培训. 表6显示在搜索和救援项下收入较低和召回较高,将选择标准的好处隔离开来。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SAR , a context-aware generation order that, at every AR step, ranks the still-uncommitted positions by similarity to a prompt-derived anchor (the conditioning embedding the base model already maintains) and commits the most relevant ones first; SAR introduces no new parameters and runs purely at inference. Across 8 8 checkpoints spanning both AR paradigms (MAR, MaskGen, VAR, Infinity) and four standard benchmarks plus our complex long-prompt benchmark, SAR consistently improves prompt alignment and compositional reasoning while preserving distribution-level aesthetic quality, and qualitatively elicits two complementary reasoning behaviors: outline-first decoding in scale-wise models and object-by-object decoding in patch-wise models. The fact that this implicit visual planning emerges for free from the model’s own representations suggests that generation order is a critical and underexplored axis of AR image modeling, with richer anchors and combinations with aesthetic-aware criteria as natural directions for further gains.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了合成孔径雷达(SAR)这一具有上下文意识的生成顺序,在每一个AR步骤中,都按照与即时生成锚(嵌入基模已经保持的前提)的相似程度对仍然未承诺的位置进行排序,并首先承诺最相关的基准;合成孔径雷达没有引入新的参数,只是推论而已。 搜索和救援工作跨越8个检查站,跨越AR范式(MAR、MaskGen、VAR、Infinity)和4个标准基准,加上我们复杂的长时速基准,不断改进快速对齐和组成推理,同时保持分布水平的审美质量,并在质量上引出两个互补的推理行为:规模模型中的大纲第一解码和补丁模型中的对象逐项解码。 这种隐含的视觉规划不拘泥于模型本身的表达,这一事实表明,生成顺序是AR图像模型的关键和未得到充分探索的轴心,更丰富的锚点和与美学认识标准的结合是进一步收益的自然方向。

We sample with T = 32 T{=}32 AR steps, CFG scale 3.0 3.0 with a linear schedule, and an aesthetic micro-conditioning score of 6.5 6.5 , matching the original MaskGen recipe.

blocks.en: Table 8 reports a separate training-time experiment from the inference-order comparison in Table 7 .
